articles.title_en: Enhancing the face validity of choice experiments: A simple diagnostic check
articles.title_cn: 增强选择实验的表面效度：一个简单的诊断检查
articles.abstract_en: We propose a simple diagnostic check for face validity assessment of willingness to pay (WTP) estimates derived from choice experiments (CEs). The check is based on a threshold value for WTP that is related to the highest cost attribute level, which can be used to assess plausibility of estimated WTP. If the threshold value is exceeded, WTP estimates are considered to overshoot. This may be due to issues with (i) the design of the CE and/or (ii) respondents' behavior deviating from assumptions underpinning CEs. Applying the check to a sample of publications, this paper provides evidence on the incidence and magnitude of overshooting of WTP in the agricultural and environmental CE literature. Based on a random sample of publications including 304 observations representing individual studies and population samples, the results show that overshooting of WTP is widespread, with 65% of observations exceeding the overshooting threshold value. An exploratory analysis to identify factors associated with overshooting of WTP across studies reveals that study design factors, and in particular the design of the cost attribute, play an important role. We recommend that researchers apply the diagnostic check for the design of choice experiments and to motivate further scrutiny of choice experiment results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种简单的诊断检查，用于评估从选择实验（CEs）中得出的支付意愿（WTP）估计的表面效度。该检查基于与最高成本属性水平相关的WTP阈值，可用于评估估计WTP的合理性。如果超过阈值，则认为WTP估计值过高。这可能是由于（i）CE的设计问题和/或（ii）受访者行为偏离CE假设所致。将该检查应用于出版物样本，本文提供了农业和环境CE文献中WTP过冲的发生率和程度的证据。基于包括304个观察值的随机出版物样本，代表个体研究和总体样本，结果表明WTP过冲普遍存在，65%的观察值超过了过冲阈值。一项探索性分析旨在识别跨研究中与WTP过冲相关的因素，结果显示研究设计因素，特别是成本属性的设计，起着重要作用。我们建议研究人员在实验设计时应用诊断检查，并进一步审查选择实验结果。

articles.title_en: How close are European countries to the doughnut-shaped safe and just space? Evidence from 26 EU countries
articles.title_cn: 欧洲国家距离甜甜圈形状的安全且公正空间有多近？来自26个欧盟国家的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study aims to measure how far 26 EU countries are from the safe and just space (SJS) defined in the Doughnut Economics framework by calculating the distance for all social and environmental dimensions and using two synthetic indices for safe space and just space. The distance was measured as a percentage of the threshold to be reached. Therefore, all indicators were interpreted in the same way. Cluster analysis was used to identify countries that displayed similar behaviours. The results showed that none of the countries analysed fall within this space. The environmental and social dimensions that most transgress were identified: CO2 emissions, biochemical flows, and social equality. The groups with the worst results were made up of countries from Southeast and East Europe, and Ireland and Luxembourg, while the best results were from Western Europe, Nordic countries and Slovenia. In conclusion, environmental transgressions and social deprivations exist in all European countries, but prosperity can be achieved through different socioeconomic models, and a high GDP does not correspond to greater sustainability. This information is valuable for the design of public policies aimed at ensuring that European society lives in the Safe and Just Space.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在通过计算所有社会和环境维度的距离，并使用两个综合指数来衡量安全空间和公正空间，从而衡量26个欧盟国家距离甜甜圈经济学框架中定义的安全且公正空间（SJS）有多远。距离以需达到阈值的百分比来衡量。因此，所有指标都以相同的方式解释。使用聚类分析来识别表现出相似行为的国家。结果表明，所分析的国家中没有一个是处于该空间内的。确定了越界最严重的环境和社会维度：二氧化碳排放、生化流动和社会平等。结果最差的群体由东南欧和东欧国家以及爱尔兰和卢森堡组成，而结果最好的来自西欧、北欧国家和斯洛文尼亚。总之，所有欧洲国家都存在环境越界和社会剥夺，但可以通过不同的社会经济模式实现繁荣，高GDP并不对应更高的可持续性。这一信息对于设计旨在确保欧洲社会生活在安全且公正空间中的公共政策具有价值。

articles.title_en: Methodological choices for reflecting strong sustainability in composite indices
articles.title_cn: 在综合指数中反映强可持续性的方法论选择
articles.abstract_en: Composite indicators are widely used to represent sustainability or its underlying dimensions. Nonetheless, an alignment between the multiple choices made during their construction and the underlying conceptual framework is often lacking. This reduces the relevance of the composite indicator.
articles.abstract_cn: 综合指标被广泛用于代表可持续性或其潜在维度。然而，在其构建过程中所做的多种选择与潜在的概念框架之间往往缺乏一致性。这降低了综合指标的相关性。

articles.title_en: Comparative analysis of Rights of Nature (RoN) case studies worldwide: Features of emergence and design
articles.title_cn: 全球自然权利（RoN）案例比较分析：出现与设计的特征
articles.abstract_en: We provide a descriptive comparative analysis of features related to emergence and design among 14 Rights of Nature (RoN) case studies worldwide. For analysis, we develop a schematic roadmap in which we categorise RoN into case studies with public guardianship and ones with appointed guardians (termed Environmental Legal Personhoods (ELPs) with further sub-categories of indirect, direct and living ELPs). Our findings suggest that RoN case studies emerged under similar circumstances where existing governance structures had been unable to protect natural environments from continued economic (urban, agricultural and industrial) activity by multiple economic actors. The strong role of local community and Indigenous Peoples in advocacy for RoN point to a divide between in situ communities and external economic agents, allowing for eco-centric value systems to emerge in juxtaposition to existing governance structures. We find that the design of RoN, however, varies in geographical entity, legal framework, legal status and guardianship. Poorly defined liability of guardians and economic agents have led to the overturning of two case studies, which stands in contrast to well-defined rights and liabilities in other case studies, suggesting that attention to liability may be an important building block for the effectiveness of RoN to protect biodiversity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对全球14个自然权利（RoN）案例中与出现和设计相关的特征进行了描述性比较分析。为进行分析，我们制定了一个示意性路线图，将RoN划分为具有公共监护的案例和具有指定监护人的案例（称为环境法律人格（ELP），并进一步细分为间接、直接和生命ELP子类别）。我们的研究结果表明，RoN案例在类似情况下出现，即现有治理结构未能保护自然环境免受多个经济行为者持续的（城市、农业和工业）经济活动的影响。当地社区和原住民在倡导RoN中的强大作用表明，原地社区与外部经济行为者之间存在分歧，使得生态中心价值体系能够在与现有治理结构并列的情况下出现。然而，我们发现RoN的设计在地理实体、法律框架、法律地位和监护方面各不相同。监护人和经济行为者的责任界定不清导致两个案例被推翻，这与其他案例中明确界定的权利和责任形成对比，表明对责任的关注可能是RoN有效保护生物多样性的重要组成部分。

articles.title_en: Maintaining human wellbeing as socio-environmental systems undergo regime shifts
articles.title_cn: 社会-环境系统经历状态转变时维持人类福祉
articles.abstract_en: Global environmental change is pushing many socio-environmental systems towards critical thresholds, where ecological systems’ states are on the precipice of tipping points and interventions are needed to navigate or avert impending transitions. Flickering, where a system vacillates between alternative stable states, is an early warning signal of transitions to alternative ecological regimes. However, while flickering may presage an ecological tipping point, these dynamics also pose unique challenges for human adaptation. We link an ecological model that can exhibit flickering to a model of human environmental adaptation to explore the impact of flickering on the utility of adaptive agents. When adaptive capacity is low, flickering causes wellbeing to decline disproportionately. As a result, flickering dynamics move forward the optimal timing of a transformational change that can secure wellbeing despite environmental variability. The implications of flickering on communities faced with desertification, fisheries collapse, and ecosystem change are explored as possible case studies. Flickering, driven in part by climate change and extreme events, may already be impacting communities. Our results suggest that governance interventions investing in adaptive capacity or facilitating transformational change before flickering arises could blunt the negative impact of flickering as socio-environmental systems pass through tipping points.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球环境变化正推动许多社会-环境系统逼近临界阈值，在这些阈值处，生态系统的状态处于临界点的边缘，需要干预来引导或避免即将发生的转变。闪烁现象，即系统在替代稳定状态之间摇摆，是向替代生态体制转变的早期预警信号。然而，虽然闪烁可能预示着生态临界点，但这些动态也给人类适应带来了独特的挑战。我们将一个可能表现出闪烁的生态模型与一个人对环境适应的模型联系起来，以探讨闪烁对适应性主体效用的影响。当适应能力较低时，闪烁会导致福祉不成比例地下降。因此，闪烁动态提前了转型变革的最佳时机，这种变革可以在环境多变的情况下保障福祉。本文探讨了闪烁对面临荒漠化、渔业崩溃和生态系统变化的社区的影响，作为可能的案例研究。闪烁，部分由气候变化和极端事件驱动，可能已经在影响社区。我们的结果表明，在闪烁出现之前，投资于适应能力或促进转型变革的治理干预措施，可以减轻闪烁在社会-环境系统通过临界点时产生的负面影响。

articles.title_en: Ecological-behavioral economics: Impact of information on energy-renovation decision through third-party investing
articles.title_cn: 生态行为经济学：第三方投资下信息对能源改造决策的影响
articles.abstract_en: Energy renovation faces critical challenges due to upfront costs and operational complexities, impeding its widespread adoption. Some strategies have initiated a groundbreaking economic model featuring a third-party payment mechanism. Under this innovative scheme, households redirect their energy bill savings to a third-party operator to fund renovation projects. In this study, employing a controlled laboratory experiment, we examine the diversity in preferences regarding this government policy and investigate the influence of informational tools on individuals' intentions to participate in the program. Our findings reveal that households with a strong environmental orientation, a penchant for risk-taking, and more altruistic and patient are more inclined to express interest in this program. Surprisingly, information designed to activate social norms and instill confidence in government intervention does not significantly enhance adoption intentions. Our experiment offers valuable methodological insights that can inform the implementation of effective energy renovation initiatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源改造因前期成本和运营复杂性面临严峻挑战，阻碍了其广泛采用。一些策略已启动了一种开创性的经济模式，采用第三方支付机制。在这一创新方案下，家庭将其能源账单节省的费用转给第三方运营商，以资助改造项目。在本研究中，我们通过受控实验室实验，考察了关于这一政府政策的偏好多样性，并调查了信息工具对个人参与该计划意愿的影响。我们的研究结果显示，具有强烈环保取向、偏好冒险、更利他和更有耐心的家庭更倾向于对该计划表示兴趣。令人惊讶的是，旨在激活社会规范和增强对政府干预信心的信息并未显著提高采纳意愿。我们的实验提供了有价值的方法论见解，可为实施有效的能源改造举措提供参考。

articles.title_en: Recreation in coastal environments: Estimating the non-market value of fishing harbors
articles.title_cn: 沿海环境中的休闲活动：估算渔港的非市场价值
articles.abstract_en: The importance of the fishing sector goes beyond food provisioning, by generating both positive and negative externalities. The benefits on tourism and the recreational appeal of coastal areas are often invoked among the positive externalities, even if their measurement may be hampered by the lack of market information. Non-market valuation methods can thus be useful to quantify the societal importance of fisheries. Here we focus on the recreational value of harbors by applying the travel cost method and analyzing whether small-scale vessels represent an attractive amenity for individuals engaging in outdoor recreation. We use an existing dataset with wide EU coverage, and match information on individuals' number of visits to coastal environments with fishing capacity indicators at the chosen recreational destination. The results suggest that the presence of small-scale capacity (e.g. vessels) increases the attractiveness of coastal locations, as we estimate the loss in recreational value due to a reduction in only one artisanal vessel to be 0.05€ per visit. By monetizing the welfare effects of changes in fishing capacity, these findings can justify the allocation of financial support to the small-scale fishery sector.
articles.abstract_cn: 渔业部门的重要性不仅限于食物供给，还通过产生正负外部性体现。旅游业带来的收益和沿海地区的休闲吸引力常被视为正外部性之一，尽管其衡量可能因缺乏市场信息而受阻。因此，非市场价值评估方法可用于量化渔业的社会重要性。本文通过应用旅行成本法，聚焦于渔港的休闲价值，并分析小型渔船是否为参与户外休闲活动的个体提供有吸引力的便利设施。我们使用一个覆盖欧盟范围的现有数据集，将个体访问沿海环境的次数信息与所选休闲目的地的捕捞能力指标进行匹配。结果表明，小型捕捞能力（如渔船）的存在增加了沿海地点的吸引力，因为我们估计仅减少一艘手工渔船导致的休闲价值损失为每次访问0.05欧元。通过将捕捞能力变化的福利效应货币化，这些发现可以为向小型渔业部门分配财政支持提供依据。

articles.title_en: What does degrowth do in/to empirical research? Methodological deliberations on placing degrowth ‘in the world’
articles.title_cn: 去增长在实证研究中做什么？关于将去增长‘置于世界中’的方法论思考
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates how the notion of degrowth directs our focus as researchers, which leads us to deliberate on the consequences of empirically placing degrowth ‘in the world.’ We propose to rethink methodological questions about how phenomena are put into relation with notions of degrowth (or not) – and our own role as researchers in this process. Mobilizing the concept of diffraction, we argue that careful attention must be paid to what notions of ‘degrowth’ do in/to our research practices, including their role in researchers' selecting, thinking and talking about social phenomena – as well as the material and discursive practices encountered in fieldwork. This is illustrated through engagement with two studies, which undertook research on a housing community in Manchester (United Kingdom) and eco-social entrepreneurs in Stuttgart (Germany). Analyzing these cases with a diffractive lens, we show how an attunement to difference allows for attention to be paid to the ‘translation’ and ‘operationalization’ of degrowth in (research) practice. This orientation, we suggest, can help scholars with the inevitable negotiations intrinsic to the choice of how and whether to engage with and understand degrowth in empirical research.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了去增长概念如何引导我们作为研究者的关注点，这促使我们思考在实证中将去增长‘置于世界中’的后果。我们提议重新思考方法论问题，即现象如何与去增长概念（或不与）建立联系——以及我们作为研究者在这一过程中的角色。通过运用衍射概念，我们认为必须仔细关注‘去增长’概念在我们的研究实践中所起的作用，包括它们在研究者选择、思考和谈论社会现象中的作用——以及田野调查中遇到的物质和话语实践。通过与两项研究的互动来说明这一点，这两项研究分别对曼彻斯特（英国）的一个住房社区和斯图加特（德国）的生态社会企业家进行了研究。通过衍射透镜分析这些案例，我们展示了对差异的关注如何使人们注意到去增长在（研究）实践中的‘翻译’和‘操作化’。我们认为，这种取向可以帮助学者们应对在实证研究中选择如何以及是否参与和理解去增长所固有的不可避免的协商。

articles.title_en: Integrating modelling-based and stakeholder-focused scenario approaches to close the planning gap and accelerate low-carbon transitions
articles.title_cn: 整合基于建模和利益相关者聚焦的情景方法，以弥合规划差距并加速低碳转型
articles.abstract_en: While many transition scenarios describe potential low-carbon systems, few link these system-level outcomes to the microlevel stakeholder decision-making needed to actualise them, resulting in a ‘planning gap’. Closing this gap requires that insights from modelling-based transition scenarios on what must happen to achieve climate targets are linked to those on how to make it happen from stakeholder-focused transition scenarios. This link requires a different understanding of decision-making rationality from that of a representative agent with rational expectations, as employed in much climate-change modelling currently. Rationality conceived as ‘frame-sensitive reasoning’ can better account for heterogenous stakeholders' alternative preferences, the actions they take in pursuit of them, and the effect of these actions on low-carbon transitions. This paper augments the Intuitive Logics (IL) stakeholder-focused scenario approach to enable frame-sensitive reasoning and provide modelling-based transition scenarios with realistic innovation-diffusion assumptions. In so doing, the paper assists in closing the planning gap.
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然许多转型情景描述了潜在的低碳系统，但很少有情景将这些系统层面的结果与实现这些结果所需的微观层面利益相关者决策联系起来，从而导致“规划差距”。弥合这一差距需要将基于建模的转型情景中关于实现气候目标必须采取的措施的见解，与基于利益相关者聚焦的转型情景中关于如何实现这些目标的见解联系起来。这种联系需要对决策理性有不同的理解，不同于当前许多气候变化建模中所采用的代表性主体理性预期。将理性视为“框架敏感推理”可以更好地解释异质性利益相关者的替代偏好、他们为实现这些偏好所采取的行动，以及这些行动对低碳转型的影响。本文增强了利益相关者聚焦的直觉逻辑（IL）情景方法，以实现框架敏感推理，并为基于建模的转型情景提供现实的创新扩散假设。通过这样做，本文有助于弥合规划差距。

articles.title_en: Quantifying the impact: Are coastal areas impoverished by marine pollution?
articles.title_cn: 量化影响：沿海地区是否因海洋污染而贫困？
articles.abstract_en: We propose a methodological framework to assess the causal impact of Harmful Algal Bloom (HAB) events on economic indicators at a territorial level, with special consideration for spatial effects. Using the Mar Menor region in Spain as a case study, we empirically apply our framework. Our findings indicate a significantly negative causal effect of marine pollution resulting from HAB events on income per capita at the census section level. We observe that this effect is exacerbated by spatial interactions among neighboring census sections adjacent to those directly affected by seawater degradation. These results underscore the importance of implementing effective environmental regulations to mitigate seawater pollution and proactive measures to safeguard the well-being of local populations. Our research provides valuable insights for future studies in similar coastal regions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个方法论框架，用于评估有害藻华（HAB）事件对领土层面经济指标的因果影响，并特别考虑空间效应。以西班牙马尔梅诺尔地区为案例研究，我们实证应用了该框架。我们的研究结果表明，在人口普查区层面，HAB事件导致的海洋污染对人均收入具有显著的负向因果效应。我们观察到，这种效应因邻近受海水退化直接影响区域的人口普查区之间的空间相互作用而加剧。这些结果强调了实施有效环境法规以减轻海水污染以及采取积极措施保护当地居民福祉的重要性。我们的研究为未来类似沿海地区的研究提供了有价值的见解。

articles.title_en: Toxic pollution and poverty: Economic impacts of lead (Pb) exposure on household welfare in Zambia
articles.title_cn: 有毒污染与贫困：铅暴露对赞比亚家庭福利的经济影响
articles.abstract_en: Environmental degradation due to human economic activities is closely linked to poverty in developing countries and can have long-term effects on well-being and sustainable development. This study investigates the nexus between toxic pollution and poverty by examining the economic impacts of lead (Pb) exposure on household welfare in Kabwe, Zambia. Kabwe, once a lead and zinc mining center, is now one of the world's most polluted urban areas, with high soil and air lead levels posing substantial health risks. We conducted a household survey and collected blood samples, matching socioeconomic data with blood lead levels (BLLs). Our empirical strategy uses variations in soil lead concentration across Kabwe neighborhoods to assess the causal impact of lead exposure on household welfare dimensions, such as consumption, education, health, and labor supply. Results show that a 1% increase in adult BLLs reduces per capita household consumption by 0.1–0.2% and increases the probability of being below the poverty line. Additionally, BLLs negatively affect adult health and children's schooling, while healthcare costs and labor supply remain unaffected. These findings suggest that lead exposure exacerbates poverty, hinders human capital accumulation, and has long-lasting implications for sustainable development.
articles.abstract_cn: 人类经济活动造成的环境退化与发展中国家的贫困密切相关，并可能对福祉和可持续发展产生长期影响。本研究通过考察赞比亚卡布韦铅暴露对家庭福利的经济影响，探讨有毒污染与贫困之间的关系。卡布韦曾是铅锌开采中心，现已成为世界上污染最严重的城区之一，土壤和空气中的高铅水平构成重大健康风险。我们进行了家庭调查并采集了血样，将社会经济数据与血铅水平进行匹配。我们的实证策略利用卡布韦各社区土壤铅浓度的差异，评估铅暴露对家庭福利维度（如消费、教育、健康和劳动力供给）的因果影响。结果显示，成人血铅水平每增加1%，人均家庭消费减少0.1-0.2%，并增加低于贫困线的概率。此外，血铅水平对成人健康和儿童学业产生负面影响，而医疗费用和劳动力供给不受影响。这些发现表明，铅暴露加剧贫困，阻碍人力资本积累，并对可持续发展具有长期影响。
